plugins.name: referent
plugins.description: Legal AI Native CRM for law firms. Connects Claude to your firm's workspace over MCP: clients, matters, tasks, time tracking, calendar, documents, and billing.

skills.name: billing-prep
skills.description: Assemble and review a pre-bill in Referent before an invoice goes to a client — collecting unbilled time and disbursements, auditing narratives, flagging write-off candidates, and checking the bill against the fee agreement. Use when the user mentions billing, invoicing, a pre-bill, month-end, WIP review, or getting bills out.

skills.name: matter-brief
skills.description: Get up to speed on a matter in Referent — status, chronology, upcoming deadlines, recent documents and correspondence, open tasks, and financial position. Use when the user asks what is happening on a matter, wants a status update or handover note, is preparing for a client call or hearing, or asks what is due this week.

skills.name: matter-intake
skills.description: Run new client and new matter intake in Referent — conflicts check, party capture, scope and fee terms, opening the matter, and preparing an engagement letter for the lawyer to sign. Use when the user mentions a new client, a new enquiry, opening a matter, onboarding, or running a conflicts check.
headings: Opening a new matter in Referent
2. Capture the parties and the enquiry

skills.name: time-entry
skills.description: Capture billable time into Referent and write client-ready narratives. Use when the user wants to log time, bill hours, record what they worked on, reconstruct a timesheet from the day's work, or clean up vague or block-billed entries before they reach a client.
